method: Eight chronological 16:9 frames per clip plus complete FFmpeg decode; inspect subject motion relative to camera and physical contact. This is sampled visual review.

clips.observed_action: Three men take successive steps through rain toward the warm doorway; the umbrella and shoulders move relative to the stable buildings and fresh puddles ripple.
The woman lifts and replaces rice parcels, then reaches toward the produce; the man keeps both hands on the box. Coherent hands, packets and rigid box. The requested box lift is not present.
Two men visibly raise and carry a rigid timber beam together with stable hand grips, independent knee and shoulder movement and sunlit airborne dust.
A continuous tea stream fills the cup, then the hands tilt the teapot back and lower it. Steam rises and friends move independently in the background.
The top hand makes a small reassuring press and the three men lift their heads and exchange natural smiles. Stacked hands and fingers remain coherent.
The man moves his arms against the shutters and lowers his shoulders slightly as the sunlight broadens across the room. The shutter opening is subtle, not a dramatic full swing.
Successive waves undulate across the full water surface and reflections fragment independently; distant boat moves gradually right against the shore.
